characters.name: Kinnikuman
traits: The hero of the series: a clumsy, self-important superhero who turns out to be the exiled prince of Kinniku Star. Volumes 3–4 are the Hero Olympics (超人オリンピック), which he enters as Japan's representative and — against every expectation, his own included — **wins**, beating Robin Mask in the final. Volume 4 ends with him on a champion's world tour, starting in Hawaii. Volume 5 is his American tour: he loses to the old master Kamehame in seven seconds, is thrown out of Jesse Mayvia's gym, and is rebuilt by Kamehame into 'a body like steel' before taking the Hawaii belt in a no-rope death match — then hands the belt straight back to his teacher and swims to California because he gave the prize money away too. In America he works undercover for Doro Flairs as 'Chanel Man', wrecking rival champions to set the WSF and WSC at each other's throats, and nearly gives himself away by blurting 'パパ!' at a photograph of his own father. The volume ends at the Grand Canyon: offered a guaranteed title defence by pushing a broken Robin Mask into the gorge, he refuses — and then blows the ring apart to save him.

Boastful and posturing in public, cowardly and whiny the moment things go wrong; childish with his father, jealous of any hero more famous than him, and an incorrigible skirt-chaser. Genuinely soft-hearted underneath: he takes in the monsters he beats, mourns the ones that die, and goes to help even when the law forbids it. His wins come from 火事場のバカ力 — blind survival instinct — not skill, and he often cannot remember afterwards what he did.

characters.name: Mít (Meat)
traits: Herald from Kinniku Star who reveals Kinnikuman's royal birth and then stays on Earth as his second, manager and conscience; a small boy in glasses and cape who attends Suminoe kindergarten (running gag) and secretly works night shifts to pay their way. Through volume 5 he is at the prince's shoulder for the whole American tour, disguised alongside him as part of the Chanel Man cover, buying toy sunglasses because there are five dollars left in the budget, and — at the Grand Canyon — urging Kinnikuman to throw Robin into the gorge because 'a champion has to be ruthless'. He is overruled.

Devoted, sensible and long-suffering — the adult in the household despite being a child. Mutters about the prince's moods, takes the blame, and stands up to him only to defend someone weaker. By volume 2 he also teases the prince outright, setting him up for pratfalls and needling him about his failed romances.

characters.name: Robin Mask
traits: Britain's armoured champion — full plate armour and a closed knight's helmet. He won the previous Hero Olympics and returns as defending champion, first treating Kinnikuman as a disposable sparring partner, then beating a wounded Terryman on a technicality and withdrawing rather than take a hollow win. In the final against Kinnikuman he loses his mask, loses his temper, and finally loses the match to a reversed backbreaker. He takes the silver, declines Kinnikuman's offer of a home in Japan, and leaves on his own tour with his wife Alisa — admitting he is simply tired of being champion. Volume 5 breaks him. Stripped of the title, he has left his wife Alisa, been picked up by Sheik Seijin and used as a piece by the Alliance; he no longer remembers his own life and mistakes his opponent for Kinnikuman mid-match. He smuggles food into Kinnikuman's cell, goads him into the Grand Canyon title match, feints with the sight of Alisa in the crowd, and finally offers himself to be thrown into the gorge so his friend can keep the belt. When Kinnikuman refuses, he calls him a fool and tries to finish him with the Tower Bridge.

Haughty and condescending, but fundamentally honourable — he refuses a win he does not think he earned, and concedes cleanly when beaten. Under real humiliation (his mask torn off in front of a crowd) that control snaps and he turns genuinely murderous, which is the arc of the final.

characters.name: Vua Kinniku (King Muscle)
traits: King of Kinniku Star and Kinnikuman's father; lost his throne to King Tone. In volume 3 he comes to Earth as his son's cornerman — pleading with the Olympic committee to let Japan compete, then drilling, panicking over and cheering for him from ringside.
Blustering, self-pitying and shameless — wheedles, bribes with gyudon, then shouts 親不孝者め when refused. Softens when speaking of Meat's sacrifices for his son.

characters.name: Terryman
traits: American wrestler-hero from Texas who charges money for hero work. Across volumes 2–3 he turns from rival into Kinnikuman's closest ally: he confesses his love to Natsuko, takes Kinkotsuman's rifle bullet in the leg to save Kinnikuman, and then fights the Olympic semifinal against Robin Mask on that ruined leg.

Cool, professional and mercenary on the surface — he says plainly he does not work for free — but volumes 2 and 3 give him the series' first real heart: he loves Natsuko, he takes a bullet for a rival, and he fights hurt rather than withdraw. He also fights dirty when cornered (a hidden knuckle-duster against Robin Mask), and is ashamed of it afterwards.

characters.name: Natsuko
traits: Reporter and photographer for 週刊HERO magazine, which runs a reader-voted hero ranking that puts Kinnikuman last. She meets him chasing the Kappatoron story and then stays — covering his fights, photographing Terryman, and being turned into a giantess by Kinkotsuman's Monster Gun. After Mari, the second woman in Kinnikuman's orbit and the more constant presence.

Brash, fearless and teasing — she mocks Kinnikuman's failures to his face, then swings to open admiration once she watches him fight. Jealous and sharp-tongued with Mari, professionally pushy with her editor.

characters.name: Kinkotsuman
traits: Skeleton-themed alien from 「しゃれこうべ星」 and the series' recurring villain. Volumes 3–4 reveal he is also the bone-faced mastermind sabotaging the Hero Olympics: an invisibility ray, a voice-command mic, a fake referee, a rifle shot from the stands that hit Terryman instead, and two attempts to kidnap Kinnikuman before the weigh-in. His henchmen call him 先生. He is chased off by the space police but always escapes.
Grandiose and gloating while winning, snivelling and tearful the instant he loses, and never done vowing revenge. His underlings and even crowds call him 先生 — he is a celebrity as much as a villain.

characters.name: Ramenman
traits: China's representative, billed as the 東洋の悪魔 (Oriental Devil). He kills Brockenman in the ring, fights Kinnikuman on an ice ring, and is disqualified from the third-place match for fouling Terryman with a chained weapon. Afterwards he reveals he once lost a death-match to Kinnikuman, and demands — half furious, half pleading — that Kinnikuman take the final seriously instead of trusting to luck, or his own defeat will have meant nothing.
Cold and genuinely cruel in the ring, and a showman about it — but volume 4 gives him pride and hurt underneath: he needs the man who beat him to be worth having lost to.

characters.name: Doro Flairs
traits: Chairman (会長) of the World Superhuman Association (世界超人協会 / WSA), the body that invited Kinnikuman to America. Volume 5's American arc is his war: driven out of Los Angeles and then St. Louis by the rival WSF and WSC, he rebuilds at the hidden 'Supermen World' park in a Missouri canyon and sets Kinnikuman to work undercover as 'Chanel Man', beating up rival champions to make the two other bodies blame each other. The plan works, and by the volume's end he is openly scheming with the enemy champion Skull Bose and watching the Grand Canyon ring explode with satisfaction.

A showman and a schemer in equal parts — he builds a superhuman museum and a Disneyland knock-off out of genuine sentiment for dead wrestlers, then spends the same breath plotting. Boastful about his park, maudlin about the past, and entirely willing to spend Kinnikuman as a game piece. Treat his warmth as real and his loyalty as conditional; the volume ends without telling you which side he is on.

characters.name: Bình luận viên dẫn
traits: Young afro-haired ringside announcer calling the play-by-play of the Hero Olympics broadcast, paired with an older commentator.
Professional, unflappable, keeps the broadcast moving through absurdity.

characters.name: Mari
traits: Nursery teacher (保母) at Suminoe kindergarten, Meat's teacher, and Kinnikuman's love interest from the 'かわいいキッスの巻' chapter on; quietly cooks breakfast for the pair.

Warm, unflappable, faintly amused by Kinnikuman; kind to Meat like a teacher to a small pupil. Has a sharp side too — she rounds on Kinnikuman when he abuses a rescue for a grope, and trades barbs with Natsuko.

characters.name: Ông chú (chưa rõ tên)
traits: A gruff, scarred man in a plaid shirt who appears at the end of volume 3 telling Natsuko 「おれはキン肉マンを殺す……!」 and manhandling her until Terryman intervenes — then, across volume 4, quietly becomes Kinnikuman's ringside second: he feeds him the tactics that beat Robin Mask, protests Robin's sneak attack from the stands, thaws Robin with a defrost gun, restrains a panicking Meat, and consoles Robin after the silver medal. Everyone calls him おじさん. **His name and what he is to Natsuko are still unexplained at the end of volume 4** — the biggest open thread in the series so far.
Starts as a threat and turns into the group's gruff uncle: blunt, practical, protective of everyone including his former target, and the only adult who talks sense at ringside.

characters.name: Jesse Mayvia
traits: Hawaii champion and owner of the Jesse Palace gym, defending his belt for the 999th time when Kinnikuman challenges him. He years ago stole the championship from Kamehame and kept him on as a valet, which is the grudge the whole Hawaii arc turns on. In the double-title 'no-rope death match' he is nicknamed BIG MOUNTAIN for a defence nothing can move, until Kinnikuman's feigned despair draws him out and the 48 Killer Techniques finish him.

Contemptuous and image-conscious — he throws Kinnikuman out of his gym for losing, sneers at his 'pig body', and rigs the rules (removing the ropes) rather than fight straight. Arrogant enough to be careless at the exact moment it costs him the match.

characters.name: Tazahama
traits: Older bald, bespectacled commentator beside the announcer, whipping up excitement with a hand-drum.
Excitable and easily deflated; keeps his manners even when Robin Mask picks him up by the ankles mid-broadcast.

characters.name: Kamehame
traits: The old Hawaiian master who becomes Kinnikuman's teacher — the volume's emotional spine. Introduced as Jesse Mayvia's shabby valet, he beats the world champion in seven seconds, then reveals he is the man Mayvia robbed of the Hawaii belt and has been waiting years to take it back. He trains Kinnikuman into 'a body like steel' and hands down the 48 Killer Techniques (48の殺人技). When Kinnikuman wins and gives him the belt, he says his part is done and walks away.

Rough-looking, shaggy and bearded, but calm, courteous and deliberate — the contrast is the point. Carries an old defeat without self-pity, teaches by plain instruction rather than shouting, and lets his student inherit the dream he can no longer finish himself.

characters.name: Skull Bose
traits: Champion of the Superhuman Alliance (超人同盟 / WSF) — bald, tattooed head to foot with the word SUKARU, and the most dangerous mind in the American arc. He takes the West from the WSA, sends his tattooed thugs to seize its headquarters, headlines the WSF's lethal Lumberjack Show, and personally sets the trap that exposes 'Chanel Man', going undercover in a deerstalker and round glasses to do it. By the volume's end the rigged plane crash has made him the new world champion.

Polite, patient and entirely ruthless — he vouches for Kinnikuman in public while building the trap that will unmask him. Takes decisions over his own chairman's head. He is the one who calls Kinnikuman by his real name スグル to watch his face.

characters.name: Sheik Seijin
traits: Chairman of the Superhuman Alliance (超人同盟 / WSF), the body the public calls the Superhuman Mafia — it runs the Lumberjack Show, where superhumans kill each other for a betting crowd. He allies with the WSC to destroy the WSA, then falls out with it over who gets to deal with 'Chanel Man', and it is he who picks up the broken Robin Mask and turns him into a piece on the board.

Blunt, territorial and openly contemptuous — he throws the wounded Beauty Rhodes at his allies' feet as a 'gift'. Given to grand philosophical talk about good and evil while running a death show. Impatient with his own champion's slow scheming.

characters.name: Chủ tịch Ban tổ chức
traits: Portly, bearded head of the Hero Olympics committee, who rules Japan out of the tournament once Ultraman declines, sneers at King Muscle's pleas — then personally delivers the news when Kinnikuman is picked after all.
Pompous and cruel when he has the upper hand, all smiles once the decision goes the other way.

characters.name: Beauty Rhodes
traits: Champion of the Superhuman Council (超人評議会 / WSC) and 'the Emperor of New York' — blonde, curled, in a fur cloak and a studded eagle belt, defending his title at Madison Square Garden with an elbow drop off the top rope. Kinnikuman, disguised as Chanel Man, floors him in the crowd; later Sheik Seijin beats him bloody and dumps him in front of his own chairman, which turns the manufactured WSC–WSF quarrel into a real one.
Vain and theatrical, playing the star at every moment; genuinely a top-class wrestler under the posing, which is why his humiliation lands so hard.

characters.name: Gania Mask
traits: Robin Mask's personal trainer and second — bald, deeply lined, built like a bull in a plain tracksuit. Rides a bicycle beside his pupil on training runs, fields the press for him, and in the final breaks through the crowd to warn Kinnikuman that Robin means to kill him.
Gruff, loyal and increasingly frightened of what his own pupil is becoming; the one person who tries to stop the final going too far.

characters.name: Duke Kamata
traits: Jesse Mayvia's manager and promoter in Hawaii — bald, moustached, in a white suit, at his champion's shoulder through the whole Hawaii arc, arguing rules and working the crowd.
A fixer: smooth in public, sour in private, quick to quibble over regulations when it suits his man.

characters.name: Iwao
traits: Round-bodied, goggle-eyed lackey to Kinkotsuman; fetches Kinnikuman's victims as 'material' for the Monster Gun, works the device, and cheers the resulting kaiju on from the sidelines.
Eager, fawning, delighted by his own usefulness.

characters.name: Mayumi
traits: Bearded caped official-cum-competitor at the Hero Olympics — works the microphone before the seeding draw, gets scolded from the judges' box for growing giant, and is drafted to help lift the living-monster barbell. Addressed by everyone as 真弓くん.
Willing, put-upon, a little ridiculous.

characters.name: Công chúa Kunta
traits: Princess of the southern Roots Island (ルーツ島), who flies in on her pet bird Miss Karasu to beg Kinnikuman to drive three monsters off her island; she knows his royal identity and calls him 王子.
Earnest and dignified, but desperate enough to promise any sum; her island pays in useless giant stone money.

characters.name: Ukon
traits: The last and strongest of the three monsters ravaging Roots Island; pig-faced, endlessly boastful, and revealed mid-fight to be an immortal robot — beaten only when the islanders summon the legendary Manmora.
Loud, jeering and insufferably pleased with himself; genuinely touchy about being called a pig.

characters.name: Iyadesu Harisun
traits: Chairman of the Superhuman Council (超人評議会 / WSC), which holds the East and South. He fronts the press after his champions are beaten one by one, blames the WSF, and devises the 踏絵 test — making 'Chanel Man' trample a portrait of King Muscle to prove he is not Kinnikuman, the trap that nearly exposes him.
Corporate and composed in public, quick to shift blame, and cruel in a procedural way — his 'test' turns into a beating while he admires the accuracy of the blows.

characters.name: Kẻ mặt đá
traits: Angular, rock-faceted lieutenant to Kinkotsuman in the Hero Olympics sabotage plot — scouts, reports back, and personally runs the 「ニイタカヤマノボレ」 operation, using a Monster Gun at a zoo to enlarge animals and loose them on a reception full of superhumans.
Sly and needling with his own side, ominously courteous to his targets.

characters.name: Người tháp tùng của Rhodes (chưa rõ tên)
traits: The unnamed woman who accompanies Beauty Rhodes everywhere — the 'beautiful companion' Doro Flairs says every touring champion keeps. She speaks for him when he cannot: calming him in the crowd, screaming for help when Chanel Man floors him, facing down Sheik Seijin over his body, and finally declaring war on the WSF herself.
Cool and unimpressed at first, and the most clear-headed voice in the WSC camp once things turn violent — it is she, not the chairman, who names the WSF as the enemy.

characters.name: Tabuchi
traits: Roots Island's self-styled 'last warrior' — the others died fighting the island's monsters. Plays childish pranks on Kinnikuman (darts, sabotage) and blames them on the local children.
Short-tempered and proud, secretly childish; breaks down frustrated ('くやしい') when caught out, but ends the arc speaking seriously about what makes a hero worth a legend.

characters.name: Xướng ngôn viên Hawaii
traits: The ringside announcer for the Hawaii matches, calling the Special Match and the double-title bout alongside the commentator Tazahama.
Professional and faintly weary — he has seen Kinnikuman's ridiculous ring entrances too many times to be impressed.

related.label: his herald, servant, secretary and only real companion; they live together and squabble like family
related.description: ta/cậu, gọi tên 'Mít' (ミートくん) mặc định; tao/mày khi quát nạt hoặc bị chạm tự ái (バカヤロウ); tớ/Mít khi mếu máo kể lể, cầu an ủi; tôi/cậu (わたし/あなた) khi cãi lại, biện minh

related.label: his father, the King of Kinniku Star
related.description: con/ba (パパ) — giọng trẻ con, nhõng nhẽo, ăn vạ, đặc biệt ngoan khi được dụ bằng cơm bò

related.label: the kindergarten teacher he falls for at first sight
related.description: tôi/cô Mari (わたくし/マリさん, です/ます) — trịnh trọng, cố tỏ ra lịch thiệp; chuyển sang 'Mari' thân mật (マリちゃん) khi mừng rỡ, xúc động

related.label: the paid American hero who replaces him as Japan's official hero — rival, then wary acquaintance
related.description: tao/mày (ユー) — bực bội, nhại lại lối 'ミー/ユー' Tây hoá của Terryman

related.label: the HERO magazine reporter who covers him, mocks him and becomes a fixture at his side
related.description: ta/cô (わたし/あなた) khi mới gặp, còn cảnh giác; thân rồi gọi biệt danh 'Nát' (ナッちゃん) — tự tin nhờ vả, đùa cợt; nổi giận ghen tuông thì 'mày, con nhỏ lăng nhăng' (おまえ, 尻軽女)

related.label: the skeleton alien who keeps coming back to destroy him — his first recurring enemy
related.description: bọn ta/(không gọi tên) (ぼくたち) khi tuyên bố chính nghĩa; 'ta/ngươi' (貴様) khi giễu cợt lúc hắn mất vũ khí; giọng nể phục 'gã đó' (やつ) khi thấy hắn thua mà vẫn gan lì

related.label: the boastful pig-faced monster on Roots Island who turns out to be an immortal robot
related.description: ta/mày (おまえ) — bực bội phản pháo khi bị chê giữa trận: 'やな性格だのうおまえ'

related.label: the armoured British champion who first uses him as a sparring partner, then becomes a respected rival
related.description: ta/anh — bực bội khi bị coi thường, chuyển sang lo lắng và nể trọng khi thấy anh thi đấu đàng hoàng

related.label: China's representative, the 'Oriental Devil', who fights him on an ice ring
related.description: ta/mày — đối đầu, cảnh giác trước một đối thủ tàn nhẫn

related.label: the committee head who first bars Japan, then picks him
related.description: ta/ông — tức giận chất vấn khi bị loại, lễ phép hơn khi được chọn

related.label: the scarred man who swore to kill him and became his ringside second
related.description: ta/ông (chưa rõ tên) — lúc đầu cảnh giác, sau tin tưởng nghe theo chiến thuật ông chỉ

related.label: Robin Mask's trainer, who breaks ranks to warn him his pupil means to kill him
related.description: ta/ông — nghe lời cảnh báo giữa lúc hỗn loạn

related.label: the old Hawaiian master who rebuilds him and hands down the 48 Killer Techniques
related.description: con/thầy — mở đầu cảnh giác, gọi trống 'thằng kia' (きさま), rồi chuyển sang lịch sự 'ông' (あなた, です/ます) khi nể phục, và gọi thẳng tên 'Kamehame' lúc hoảng hốt cầu cứu giữa trận

related.label: the Hawaii champion he beats for the double title
related.description: tôi/cậu Meibia (メイビアくん) khi nhún nhường trước đám đông; 'mày' (きさま) khinh miệt lúc tung đòn quyết định; 'anh' (キミ) đắc thắng khi lật tẩy màn kịch

related.label: the WSA chairman who employs him and sends him undercover
related.description: con/ngài chủ tịch (会長) — lịch sự, có phần e dè trước bề trên; vẫn giữ 会長 cả khi lo lắng trách nhẹ

related.label: the enemy champion who shelters him in public and traps him in private
related.description: tôi/Skull (スカル, gọi trống tên, suồng sã) — giọng 'Chanel Man' bụi bặm, không phải giọng thường ngày

related.label: the WSF chairman who suspects his cover from the first day
related.description: tao (オレ, giọng đường phố của vỏ bọc Chanel Man) — thô lỗ, gắt, cố tình tách mình khỏi 'cái tên Kinnikuman dở hơi kia'

related.label: his prince and master, whom he serves, scolds and covers for
related.description: em/ngài, hoàng tử (ぼく/王子, です/ます) mặc định; 'hoàng tử ơi' giọng van nài khi ngăn cản; giọng trách móc 'em/anh' (ぼく/あなた) khi đổ lỗi; hiếm hoi gằn giọng 'Hoàng tử im lặng giùm em!' (王子はだまっててください!) khi bênh vực người khác

related.label: his kindergarten teacher, who also cooks for him and Kinnikuman
related.description: con/cô (わたくし, です/ます) — lễ phép, hơi ấp úng như học trò với cô giáo; bỏ lễ phép thành 'tớ cũng!' (わしも!) khi nũng nịu đòi được hôn như hoàng tử

related.label: the American hero who treats him as a friend
related.description: em/anh Terryman (gọi thẳng tên, hớt hải) khi cảnh báo nguy hiểm; giữ です/ます lịch sự khi giải thích, từ chối lời rủ

related.label: the reporter who treats him as a little brother
related.description: em/chị — ngắn gọn, thân mật, không kính ngữ

related.label: the king, who drills and scolds him while they train the prince
related.description: em/Đại vương (大王さま, です/ます) — lễ phép nhưng dám càu nhàu lại

related.label: the fallen champion he walks through the prison corridor with, then screams a warning to
related.description: em/anh Robin — hoảng loạn gọi gộp 'Vương tử, Robin, chạy đi!' khi máy bay lao xuống

related.label: the reject he recruits as a sparring partner, then comes to respect
related.description: ta/cậu (わたし/キミ) — kiêu ngạo, bề trên; 'tao/mày' đe doạ ép đầu hàng khi khoá đòn

related.label: his semifinal opponent, whom he beats on a technicality and then defers to
related.description: ta/(quát trống) 'じゃまだ!!' khi hung hãn; gần như van nài 'おねがいだ…おきてこないでくれ' khi lo cho đối thủ; trang trọng gọi đủ tên 'Terryman' khi tuyên bố nhường suất chung kết

related.label: the ringside commentator he answers curtly and then teases
related.description: ta/(không gọi tên) — đáp cộc lốc, rồi túm chân xốc ngược ông ta lên đùa nghịch

related.label: his personal trainer and second
related.description: ta/Gania (gọi tên rút gọn) — thừa nhận đã nương tay; quát 'どけガニア!!' xua ông ra khi đang điên

related.label: his opponent's father, whom he answers politely
related.description: tôi/(không gọi tên) (わたし, です/ます) — lễ phép, điềm tĩnh; thú nhận thật lòng rằng mình đã mệt với ngôi vô địch

related.label: the committee head he petitions
related.description: tôi/Chủ tịch (委員長, です/ます) — trịnh trọng đề đạt luật Count-3 vì thấy chênh lệch thực lực quá lớn

related.label: the prince's herald, who he snaps at across the ring
related.description: ta/thằng ngốc (バカモノ, わい) — cộc cằn, khinh miệt

related.label: his son, the prince he abandoned on Earth and now needs
related.description: ta/con, gọi thẳng tên 'Suguru' (わし/おまえ, スグル) mặc định; van nài, dỗ ngọt bằng cơm bò; quát 'thằng con bất hiếu' (親不孝者め) khi bị từ chối; trầm giọng nghiêm túc khi kể chuyện Meat hi sinh

related.label: his son's herald, whom he drills alongside him
related.description: ta/Mít (ミートくん) — quát tháo trong lúc huấn luyện, lo lắng khi cần tin tức

related.label: the committee head who humiliates him
related.description: ta/ông — nài nỉ rồi phẫn nộ khi bị gạt phắt và bị chê là 'nỗi nhục của Nhật Bản'

related.label: the official who taunts him about his son
related.description: ta/cậu Mayumi — quát nạt, tát thẳng rồi viện điều lệ số 264

related.label: the local hero he displaces, then respects

related.description: tôi/cô (わたし/おじょうさん, です/ます) khi tán tỉnh khéo; gọi thẳng tên tha thiết 'Natsuko' khi van xin và thổ lộ — 'ナツコを愛している‼'

related.label: Kinnikuman's boy herald, whom he treats as a pal
related.description: tôi/Mít (ミートくん) — thân thiện, rủ đi chơi như bạn bè

related.label: the island princess who hires him for money
related.description: tôi/(không gọi tên) (おれ) khi nhận việc, ngầm hiểu sẽ được trả hậu; 'Mi/các người' (ミー/ユーたち) khi giễu cợt cách trả công bằng tiền đá cổ lỗ

related.label: the armoured champion he fights in the Olympic semifinal, who then hands him the final place
related.description: tôi/anh — căng thẳng đối đầu; hoảng hốt van nài 'đừng đứng dậy nữa' khi sợ thua; nhận suất chung kết trong ngượng ngùng

related.label: the villain whose sniper bullet he took in the leg
related.description: tôi/hắn (キン骨マン, gọi thẳng tên) — kể lại vụ bắn lén bằng giọng nghiêm trọng, đau đớn

related.label: the hero she covers, mocks, then champions
related.description: tui/anh (うち/あんた, giọng Kansai) mặc định; gọi thẳng tên thật 'Suguru' (スグル) khi tự hào khoe với đám đông; biệt danh thân mật 'Kin' (キンちゃん) khi nhắc tới anh với người khác; quát 'đồ khốn' (バッキャロー) khi anh đập phá đồ của cô

related.label: the American hero she photographs and openly admires
related.description: em/anh Terryman (わたし/テリーマンさん) — ngưỡng mộ, hơi say mê; bỏ さん gọi trống 'anh' (あなた) khi chủ động rủ chụp ảnh chung

related.label: her rival for Kinnikuman's attention
related.description: tui/cô ta (gọi trống, mỉa mai) — ghen tị, châm chọc vẻ trong sáng giả tạo

related.label: Kinnikuman's boy herald, whom she treats as a little brother
related.description: tui/Mít (ミートくん) — suồng sã, thân mật

related.label: his arch-enemy
related.description: ta/lũ ngươi (おまえたち, gộp cả Mít) khi ngạo mạn; gọi thẳng tên 'Kinnikuman' khi đắc thắng lộ bẫy; thua vẫn gằn 'ここのうらみはわすれんからな!'

related.label: his round-bodied lackey
related.description: ta/Iwao (gọi thẳng tên) — sai khiến, khen thưởng cộc lốc ('でかしたぞイワオ!')

related.label: the hero who took his sniper bullet
related.description: ta/mày — bắn lén từ khán đài, không đối mặt

related.label: his rock-faced lieutenant
related.description: ta/mày — gắt gỏng, sai khiến; nhận báo cáo trinh sát

related.label: his Block B opponent on the ice ring
related.description: ta/'tay làm xiếc' (曲芸師) — giễu cợt khi đối thủ nhảy nhót né đòn

related.label: the champion he invited to America and then used as an undercover weapon against the rival bodies
related.description: ta/ngươi (わし/きさま) khi ra lệnh, nghiêm giọng bề trên; 'cái thằng Kinnikuman này' (キン肉マンめ) khi càu nhàu sau lưng; 'các ngươi' (キミたち) khi hài lòng khen ngầm cả hai thầy trò

related.label: the enemy body's champion he ends up scheming with
related.description: ta/Skull (スカル, gọi trống tên, không kính ngữ) — xẳng giọng chất vấn, rồi khen 'スカルよくやったぞ' khi vừa ý

related.label: the fallen champion he tries to buy
related.description: ta/ông (gọi đủ 'ロビン・マスク') — lịch sự có tính mua chuộc

related.label: the henchman he sends to crash the plane into the ring
related.description: ta/Iwao (gọi trống tên, ra lệnh cộc lốc)

related.label: the champion he interviews at ringside
related.description: tôi/anh Robin (ロビンさん, です/ます) — lịch sự, trang trọng trước ống kính

related.label: his broadcast partner
related.description: tôi/ông Tazahama (タザハマさん, です/ます) — lịch sự mời bình luận

related.label: the odd neighbour-hero who courts her
related.description: em/anh (あたし/あなた, です/ます) — tò mò rồi ngạc nhiên thích thú khi biết anh nổi tiếng

related.label: her pupil at the kindergarten
related.description: cô/Mít (わたし/ミートくん) — thân mật kiểu cô giáo với học trò nhỏ, âu yếm khi cảm ơn

related.label: her rival for Kinnikuman's attention
related.description: em/cô (わたし/あなた, です/ます nhưng gằn giọng) — khó chịu khi bị dò hỏi; châm chọc ngược 'わたしで69人めだ!' khi bị xúc phạm

related.label: the woman he threatened over Kinnikuman — the connection is never explained
related.description: tao/Natsuko (gọi thẳng tên) — gầm lên đầy hận thù, ghì chặt không buông

related.label: the man he swore to kill, then seconded to the championship
related.description: tao/Kinnikuman (gọi thẳng tên) — gấp gáp, ra lệnh ở sát dây đài, ép nghe chiến thuật

related.label: his man's opponent, whom he defends, rescues and then consoles
related.description: tôi/Robin Mask (gọi đủ tên) khi phẫn nộ tố cáo đánh úp; 'Robin' rút gọn, dịu hẳn khi cứu và an ủi

related.label: the king he guides and argues with at the stadium
related.description: tôi/ông (おじさん thân mật nhưng giữ ですか lịch sự) — vừa can ngăn vừa lo thật lòng cho con trai ông

related.label: the boy he calms down
related.description: chú/Mít (ミートくん) — ghì giữ, trấn an bằng giọng thân thiết

related.label: a hero he already seems to know
related.description: chú/cậu Terryman (テリーマンくん) — thân mật như quen từ trước

related.label: the visiting champion he despises, then loses both belts to
related.description: ta/(không gọi tên) khinh miệt, 'đồ ngu' (バカもの!) khi gắt; ta/cậu Meibia… ngược lại, gọi 'vương tử' (王子) hoặc thêm くん khi làm ra vẻ lịch thiệp trước đám đông

related.label: his manager and fixer
related.description: ta/Kamata (gọi trống tên, plain) — tin cậy, bàn mưu ngang hàng

related.label: the man he took the belt from and kept as his valet
related.description: ta/(gọi trống, khinh) — coi như người hầu, không bao giờ gọi bằng tên tôn trọng

related.label: the champion he tries to interview
related.description: tôi/anh Robin (ロビンさん, です/ます) — lịch sự; giãy nảy 'わー ゆするな' khi bị túm chân đùa nghịch

related.label: his student and the heir to his unfinished dream
related.description: thầy/con (わたし/キミ, キン肉マン) mặc định, trầm tĩnh; chuyển sang giọng giảng bài lịch sự (です/ます) khi dạy đòn, vẫn giọng đó khi trêu 'vương tử dở hơi'; nghiêm giọng ra lệnh 'よくきけ' lúc mách nước giữa trận

related.label: the man who took his belt and made him a valet
related.description: ta/hắn (やつ) — nói về chứ hiếm khi nói với; giọng nén, không gào

related.label: his chairman, whom he manages as much as he serves
related.description: tôi/Sheik (わたし/シーク, です/ます) — lịch sự nhưng cứng rắn khi biện hộ; nâng lên 'ngài Sheik' (シークさま) khi trấn an hoặc cần được cho qua

related.label: the infiltrator he protects in public and traps in private
related.description: tôi/Chanel Man (シャネルマン) trước mặt mọi người, quát 'いいかげんにしろ' khi cần diễn; gọi thẳng tên thật 'cậu Suguru' (スグルくん) khi dò phản ứng — đó là lúc nguy hiểm nhất

related.label: the rival chairman he ends up scheming with
related.description: tôi/(không gọi tên, です/ます) — trình bày mưu kế như báo cáo công việc

related.label: his champion, who increasingly acts without him
related.description: ta/Skull à (スカルよ, gọi trống kèm よ, bề trên) — thúc giục, chất vấn

related.label: the rival chairman he hunts out of two cities
related.description: ta/lão Flairs (フレアースよ, おまえ) — xấc xược, gọi trống tên

related.label: the allied champion he mocks and then maims
related.description: ta/mày (おまえ) — mỉa mai, gọi 'thân hình béo phì' (肥満体)

related.label: the infiltrator he suspects from the first day
related.description: tụi tao/tụi bay (わしら/きさまら) khi tố cáo; 'mày' (おまえ) giễu cợt khi vạch vỏ bọc

related.label: the foreign king he humiliates
related.description: ta/ngươi (おまえ, キサマ) — coi thường, cười khẩy 'それこそ日本の恥ですわ!'

related.label: the fighter he eventually selects
related.description: ta/cậu (わし/キミ) — hồ hởi chúc mừng khi báo tin được chọn

related.label: nominal ally, then the man who maims him
related.description: ta/anh Sheik (シーク, gọi trống tên) — xẵng nhưng vẫn õng ẹo, tranh phần trước

related.label: the rival chairman he cuts off mid-sentence
related.description: ta/ông (không gọi tên) — ngạo mạn, cười ホホホホホ

related.label: his pupil
related.description: tôi/Robin (gọi tên rút gọn) — lo lắng gọi tên; kinh hãi khi đoán ra học trò sắp tung đòn cấm

related.label: his pupil's opponent, whom he runs to warn
related.description: tôi/cậu (ユー, kiểu Tây hoá) — hớt hải: 'ロビンはユーを殺すつもりだ!!'

related.label: the commentator he rounds on
related.description: tôi/đồ ngốc (バカモノ) — quát mắng và giẫm lên ông ta vì buông lời khen thản nhiên trước một đòn chết người

related.label: his champion and employer
related.description: tôi/anh (không gọi tên) — chờ lệnh, hỏi lại ngắn 'なにかね'

related.label: his master
related.description: em/tiên sinh (先生) — lễ phép báo cáo, xin ý kiến ('いかがでしょうか先生!')

related.label: the prince she comes to beg for help
related.description: em/hoàng tử (わたし/王子, です/ます) — tha thiết cầu xin, biết rõ thân phận thật của anh

related.label: the hero she hires for money
related.description: em/anh (わたし) — khẩn khoản, hứa trả bao nhiêu cũng được

related.label: the hero sent to drive him off the island
related.description: tao/mày (おまえ) — khinh miệt, chê bai giữa trận ('なさけないのうおまえ'); cười lớn ngạo nghễ khi đòn Kinniku Flash bật ngược

related.label: his champion
related.description: tôi/Rhodes (gọi trống tên) — bàng hoàng gọi tên khi thấy anh ta bị đánh gục

related.label: the suspect he tests with his father's portrait
related.description: tôi/anh (あんた) — dò hỏi lịch sự vừa phải, bên dưới là nghi ngờ

related.label: ally against the WSA, then rival over jurisdiction
related.description: tôi/(không gọi tên, です/ます) — giữ lễ ngay cả khi tranh quyền

related.label: his leader
related.description: em/tiên sinh (先生, です/ます) khi báo cáo; suồng sã trêu lại khi thấy hắn cũng nhảy múa ăn mừng

related.label: the target he greets by his real name
related.description: tôi/cậu Suguru (スグルさん) — lễ phép lạnh gáy, cho thấy hắn biết rõ thân phận thật

related.label: the champion she accompanies and speaks for
related.description: tôi/Rhodes (gọi trống tên) — thản nhiên khi trấn an, hét gọi khi hoảng

related.label: the enemy chairman she confronts over Rhodes' body
related.description: tôi/Sheik (gọi trống tên) — lạnh, dò xét, rồi tuyên chiến

related.label: the outsider hero he resents, pranks, then respects
related.description: tôi/hoàng tử (オレ/王子) — trầm ngâm, động viên anh phải trở thành anh hùng xứng tầm truyền thuyết

related.label: the commentator beside him at the desk
related.description: tôi/anh Tazahama (タザハマさん, です/ます) — than thở thân mật trong lúc chờ trận
